purpose: Shows who is part of something as an overlapping stack of avatars, each in a Surface/page ring, ending in a +N tile for the rest.

notFor.case: A full list of people with names and details.

Default.visual: Each avatar in a Surface/page ring; the +N tile Surface/inverse with Content/inverse text.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable unless the +N tile is a button.

openQuestions: The +N tile is "a labelled image or button". Which one, and if a button, what does it open?
